Bot: Who the hell was that.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
#bot.Expression.clear
Lady Annalie: Just forget about her. She’s no one. 
You: You two seem to know each other pretty well. Are you friends?
#Annalie_Outside.face.sad
Lady Annalie: Really… Don’t you ever say something like that ever again.
You: …
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Let’s try to forget about that ***** ******* *****, ok? 
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Sure! We can’t let that girl bring our mood down. 
Lady Annalie: Let’s get to work and finish it quickly. I wouldn’t want to waste any more of your time.
You: Don’t worry about it. We are happy to help.
